rationale: M37.21 #610 scala ScalaD-E (oracle) + ScalaD-H (analyzer): trait methods declared under generic type variables (def to(t: T)) pair with substituted implementations (def to(t: AABB)) via name-only fallback — textual sig equality rejects genuine generic-substitution overrides (scala3 byname-implicits-13, spec-example1 @specialized). Concrete-vs-concrete same-name-different-sig pairs (Overloads.f) must still never pair.
notes: Generic-substitution fallback fires only when a sig carries a type-variable token; the concrete Overloads.f pair keeps the strict overload guard. Oracle mirror: hasTypeVar in deriveTreeEdges sigCompatible.
